args.title: Ignore trailing blank lines in CSV statement parsing
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parseStatement to properly handle files that end with a blank line by ignoring trailing empty lines before parsing data rows, preventing a 'Malformed row' error on the last empty line.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseStatement function in src/ingest/parser.ts currently throws a 'Malformed row' error when a file ends with a blank line because it tries to parse that empty line as a data row. The fix is to ignore trailing empty lines in the input before parsing, preventing this incorrect error for files with an empty final row.
